title: Blackguard's Sword

sources.title: Dazing Smite
markers: | summary = '''Dazing Smite''' is a passive feature that dazzles targets you hit with a Smite.

summary: A +2 longsword that can Daze a target struck with a qualifying smite.

fields.Dazing Smite: When a qualifying smite deals damage, DC 13 Constitution or Dazed for 2 turns. Some higher-level smites and interrupt Divine Smite do not trigger this passive.
fields.Base value: 250 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions.
